Recent Stay at Lemon Tree, Gurgaon – Sector 60

I recently had the opportunity to stay at Lemon Tree Hotel in Sector 60, Gurgaon. While it’s categorized as a budget hotel, I feel compelled to share my experience, especially because certain aspects of their hospitality truly stood out.

The staff are the true strength of this hotel. From the moment we checked in until our departure, every interaction was marked by courtesy, promptness, and genuine hospitality. Whether it was the chef, front office staff, transport personnel, or security team, everyone was extremely helpful and welcoming.

I’d especially like to mention a few names that I remember:

Mitali and Vishnu from the front desk

Roshan Mishra from Transport and Security Services

Apologies for not recalling all the names, but honestly, the entire team deserves appreciation. Their warmth and service truly raised the bar of what one expects from hospitality.

Another aspect that deserves special recognition is the hotel’s commitment to inclusivity. Lemon Tree employs a number of specially abled staff members that not only shows their vision of a inclusive society but also gives these special people the right to live with dignity. Truly Commendable

Thanks,
Rashmi
